defects.what: The bronze plaque above the white marble door is filled with several lines of pseudo-text.
A girl's head and face stick out of a hole in the stone wall in the middle of this background plate.
Indio's raised counting hand has fused, malformed fingers with dark blotches on the back of the hand.
The papers laid on the green treaty table carry rows of pseudo-text lines.
The note Agoncillo writes on shows scribbled pseudo-handwriting.
Garbled lettering runs around the rims of the two coins in the hand.
Open books on the front desks show small rows of pseudo-text.
Usman has two tall, pointed, upright ears (no folded ear) and a slimmer, different-breed look.
Usman has glowing blue eyes and his white chest patch is shaped like a letter M.
